hooks.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.rb$'; then bundle exec rubocop -A "$FILE" --fail-level=error 2>/dev/null || true; fi
FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.erb$'; then bundle exec erb_lint --autocorrect "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rails db:(drop|reset|seed)' && echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(production|RAILS_ENV=production)'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "BLOCKED: Never run destructive DB commands against production."}'; fi

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf\s+/'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "BLOCKED: Use trash or be more specific with rm paths."}'; fi
osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Code finished" with title "Finawise"' 2>/dev/null || true

BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); RUBY_V=$(ruby -v 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f2); RAILS_V=$(bundle exec rails -v 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f2); echo "{\"additionalContext\": \"Git branch: $BRANCH | Ruby: $RUBY_V | Rails: $RAILS_V\"}"
